Installing soilhub

Source: vignettes/installation.Rmd
installation.Rmd

This page explains how to install soilhub in R, how to update it and what to do if the installation does not work. You need R 4.1 or later. The same steps work in R, RStudio and RStudio Server.

1. Install

Copy these two lines into the R console and press Enter:

install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("giulange/soilhub-r@*release")

What they do:

  • the first line installs remotes, a small helper that installs packages published on GitHub. You need it only once;
  • the second line downloads the latest released version of soilhub and installs it. R also installs, by itself, the packages that soilhub needs (httr2, jsonlite, curl, openssl): you do not have to install them.

If R asks whether to update other packages, you can answer “None” (or press Enter): soilhub does not need newer versions of the packages you already have.

2. Check 

library(soilhub)
packageVersion("soilhub")

If the second line prints a version number, soilhub is installed. From now on, every time you start R you only need library(soilhub).

3. Maps and geometries (optional)

soilhub can return the location of the soil profiles and the shape of the map units as sf objects, ready for maps. This needs the package sf, which is not installed automatically because many users do not need it:

install.packages("sf")

Without sf everything else works; geometries can still be returned as text (with_geometry = "text").

4. Update

To move to a newer version, run the second installation line again and then restart R (in RStudio: Session > Restart R):

remotes::install_github("giulange/soilhub-r@*release")

5. If something goes wrong

What you see What to do
there is no package called 'remotes' Run the first line of step 1 again.
A message about a library that is not writable Answer “yes” when R offers a personal library.
On a Linux server, errors while installing curl, openssl or sf These packages need system libraries: ask the administrator of the server.
API rate limit exceeded from GitHub Wait a few minutes and try again, or use the file below.

Installing from a file: download soilhub_X.Y.Z.tar.gz from the releases page and run (with the real file name):

install.packages("~/Downloads/soilhub_0.2.0.tar.gz", repos = NULL, type = "source")

In this case R does not install the packages soilhub needs: install them first with install.packages(c("httr2", "jsonlite", "curl", "openssl")).

6. The development version

Only to try changes that are not released yet:

remotes::install_github("giulange/soilhub-r", ref = "develop")
